_about: Nov 1, 2026 Did You Know (R88). Source: Steven Leonowicz, Oct 29 2026 11:11 AM ET chat ('add the spectrum warning about unplugging their modem over time will require a support phone call to spectrum to reactivate the equipment'), and Chuck Silcox email to Tony Ciaramitaro, Oct 29 2026 10:32 AM ET (Steven cc'd). Wording composed only from those facts; PENDING Steven's wording approval. Oct 29 11:18 AM: reworded as one resident's report plus advice -- no official Spectrum source says an extended unplug needs a support call (Spectrum only documents a 30-60 s unplug as a normal reboot).
source_facts: add the spectrum warning about unplugging their modem over time will require a support phone call to spectrum to reactivate the equipment

I was advised that someone went traveling for a couple weeks and while gone they unplugged their modem, WiFi and tv. When they returned they had to spend about a half hour with Spectrum on the phone to reset up the entire account. And then had to set up all the other channels like Peacock etc. Maybe we need to put out a blast to not unplug your equipment during any absence.

items.title_display: Don't Unplug Your Spectrum Equipment While Away
paragraphs: One resident went traveling for a couple of weeks and unplugged their modem, WiFi and TV while away. When they returned, they spent about a half hour on the phone with Spectrum to set up the entire account again, and then had to set up all the other channels like Peacock.
Please do not unplug your equipment during any absence.
